purpose: The DDE-069 implementation ledger. Every meaningful control in the AD-035 golden Frontend Studio has exactly one row with independent DOMAIN, READ, COMMAND, UI, WIRED, E2E and VISUAL evidence. Final status is derived; backend-only evidence can never certify a missing UI.
authority: docs/truth/FRONTEND_STUDIO_REV3.md section 8 (Golden UI - quantum functional binding map); AD-035; AD-036

status_vocabulary.UNBOUND: At least one applicable evidence layer has no binding.
status_vocabulary.TYPED_UNAVAILABLE: No applicable layer is untracked, but at least one is explicitly unavailable with an honest product state.
status_vocabulary.BOUND: Every applicable layer is at least bound, but one or more layers lack verification.
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Every applicable evidence layer is independently VERIFIED.

closure_rule: A visible golden control is VERIFIED only when every applicable DOMAIN, READ, COMMAND, UI, WIRED, E2E and VISUAL layer is VERIFIED. UI and VISUAL are always applicable. TYPED_UNAVAILABLE is final only when no required layer is silently UNBOUND.

rows.note: DesignSourceRegistry is DDE-069 M8. The explorer group is listed with an UNKNOWN count (Availability.NOT_IMPLEMENTED) rather than hidden or shown as zero.
Internal source adapter is DDE-069 M8; the group reports NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Generated screens now carry mandatory visual_critique bindings whose rubric includes accessibility, so evidence has a real producer; the QaFindingInventory read that aggregates it is DDE-069 M17. Until then the badge renders Not evaluated rather than a fabricated AA.

rows.note: No orchestrator runtime is wired to the Studio; runtime_state is UNKNOWN rather than a decorative ACTIVE dot.
Manager-chair identity has no backing projection yet; the card shows no name.
Blueprint Rev 3 section 5.4 ModelServingEvidence is unimplemented, so serving_confidence is UNATTESTED and desired/configured/serving stay separate and empty.
No frontend activity projection exists; the count is UNKNOWN, not a random waveform.
Role health has no backing projection; the dot renders UNKNOWN.

The control is present where the golden composition puts it and the DesignGateway behind it is real: it compiles an allowlisted DesignEditContext, records the design-system hash, quarantines malformed artifacts and creates isolated candidates through Try live. What is absent is a certified Claude Design transport, so the provider reports NOT_CERTIFIED and the gateway refuses with no fallback. Driving it through capability.claude_code_invoke would be a generic code-generation prompt labelled /design, which section 23 forbids by name.
The canvas region exists with the correct dominance and toolbar; the code-backed preview runtime is DDE-069 M9. Showing a screenshot here would violate the LIVE-badge rule (section 9.3).
No LIVE badge is rendered because nothing satisfies its five conditions (revision + build + runtime + health + route). DDE-069 M9.

evidence_layer_vocabulary.READ: Authoritative read model used by the control.
evidence_layer_vocabulary.UI: The named visible React control or honest unavailable state.
evidence_layer_vocabulary.E2E: Real boundary exercise through the workbench.
evidence_layer_vocabulary.VISUAL: Rendered structural/visual evidence for the named control.

layer_status_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: The row's contract does not require this layer.
layer_status_vocabulary.UNBOUND: The required layer has no implementation evidence.
layer_status_vocabulary.TYPED_UNAVAILABLE: The layer is absent and surfaced honestly.
layer_status_vocabulary.BOUND: Implementation refs exist, but verification is incomplete.
